name: spoiler
title: Spoiler
description: Content hidden by a screentone, revealed on click. Block: the children stay in the layout but are inert and aria-hidden under a tone cover with a paper plate that names what is hidden ("Chapter 12 ending") and says "Tap to reveal"; the plate gets a tone shadow on hover, the cover has the ink focus ring and a pressed offset, and the content pops in on reveal with a Hide button to cover it again. Inline: a few words become an ink flat with transparent text, a paper inner line on hover, and the revealed words get a 2px underline. Controlled (revealed, onRevealedChange) or uncontrolled (defaultRevealed).
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/spoiler". The block variant hides an image or a paragraph under a screentone cover; the inline variant hides a few words inside a sentence. The reveal button is the cover itself (block) or the ink bar (inline), so it is always at least 44 px tall on phones. Use triggerProps only to pass data-* attributes (showcase states).

meta.tagline: Hidden under a screentone until the reader taps.
meta.usage:
import { Spoiler } from "@/components/manga/spoiler"

The letter was signed by the editor.

props.name: variant

props.name: label

props.name: onRevealedChange

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the root (block) or to the reveal button / revealed text (inline).
